title: Dealer Question Response Quality
summary: This topic centers on whether dealer staff answer customer questions adequately, but several fragments are too brief or generic to show a consistent experience.

positive.summary: The positive review says there were no additional issues reported by the customer.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe poorly trained dealer staff, difficulty getting questions answered after the sale, and a generally badly thought-through experience with limited detail.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention yes-or-no customer answers or wanting questions answered at the dealer, but they do not clearly state a sentiment about the experience.

limitations: Several fragments are short survey-style responses that lack enough context to interpret sentiment confidently.
One negative fragment is generic and does not clearly tie the complaint to dealer question handling, so the cluster is somewhat loosely connected.
